title: Fallen Birch
content: Study of fallen white birch, pencil, James GurneyPencil is the medium of choice when I'm more interested in form than in light or color. In this case, I was fascinated by the way the white paper-like bark peeled off the rotting log. This is a page from a 9x12 sketchbook that is devoted just to nature studies.I usually use two hardnesses of graphite: HB and 2B and switch between them.
